runs.text: What does the till gain by depending on the contract
instead of knowing each way of paying?
Depending on what an object promises, and not on which object it is, separates what changes (the payment methods) from what does not change (that the till asks to charge).
Payment methods can be added without touching it.

justification.text: A new method is a new class that meets the contract; the till stays the same.
Speed does not change: what changes is how much has to be touched to grow.
The opposite: each payment method is a class.
